Documentation: The station shall detect the presence of a bottle before beginning the filling operation.
The station shall position a detected bottle correctly before beginning the filling operation.
The station shall fill each bottle to a nominal target volume of 500 mL within a tolerance of ±5 mL.
The station shall measure the fill level after the filling operation.
The station shall accept bottles within the fill-level tolerance and reject bottles outside it.
The station shall stop the conveyor and filling operation within one second after an emergency-stop request.
